title: Civilian Rescue, Debris Lift, Escort, and Evac
description:
Purpose: Implement the civilian rescue loop: scan, clear debris with grabber hand, shield bubble placement, guide to evac pods, track progress.

Behaviour:
- Scan: Utility scanner drone from construct system marks civilian NPCs and hazards; this mechanic listens for scan events and attaches rescue waypoints.
- Debris lift: When grabber hand construct grips debris tagged CTag{"rescue_debris"}, apply lift constraints and mark civilian as freed upon removal.
- Shield bubble: Allow placing civilian shield bubble construct around NPCs under fire; bubble absorbs limited damage.
- Escort: Approach a civilian and press A (Right) on context prompt to signal follow; NPC follows at safe distance and slows when path blocked; guide them to evac_pod_prop.
- Evac: At pod trigger, NPC boards; increment rescued counter and emit progress to mission_flow_system.
- Partial credit: award per-group saves on mission end.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("interact_button", "A_right")

Components read/write:
- Reads civilian_npc_pack entities, evac_pod_prop triggers, scanner marks; writes CRescueState{ total, rescued, following }, CTag{"rescued"} on evac.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_rescue_zone_flow: Scanner reveals objectives; grabber lifts debris; shield bubble protects; civilians board pods and success tracked.

Assets/scenes: rescue_zone, alien_city; assets: civilian_npc_pack, evac_pod_prop, construct_pack_utility.
